meanings.gloss: his (with feminine nouns in the dative or genitive; genitive plural)
meanings.morph: possessive, feminine dative/genitive singular; genitive plural

sentences.text: Er ist mit seiner Frau hier.
Paul war gestern mit seiner Frau in Wien.
sentences.en: Paul was in Vienna with his wife yesterday.

sentences.text: Robert ist jetzt bei seiner Frau.
sentences.en: Robert is with his wife now.

sentences.text: Er muss mit seiner Frau sprechen.
sentences.en: He has to talk to his wife.

sentences.text: Er hat nie etwas von seiner Arbeit gesagt.
sentences.en: He never said anything about his work.

sentences.text: Er will nur das Geld seiner Frau.
sentences.en: He only wants his wife's money.
sentences.review: This is the first genitive use of 'seiner' (feminine genitive: das Geld seiner Frau), but the attached concept covers only the dative, and case.genitive covered only masculine/neuter des/eines; add a note or extend an explanation for feminine/plural genitive -er.

sentences.text: Es geht um das Leben seiner Kinder.
